_note: Previous benchmarks were computed on hand-typed, unverified sales and were removed 2026-11-16. No valuation back-test has been run against real recorder data.
_evidence: Audit 2026-11-16: 5 of 6 Los Angeles 'parcelId' values in scripts/run_valuation_backtests.mjs do not exist in the LA County parcel layer (public.gis.lacounty.gov LACounty_Parcel/MapServer/0); the sixth (AIN 4091001009) exists but its roll land value (411,981), land base year (2013) and living area (1,363 sq ft) do not match the script (620,000 / 2020 / 2,150). King, Harris, Hillsborough and Cook 'parcel IDs' are arithmetic sequences (step 35 or 45); Cook PINs are 14 digits, the script's are 10. See docs/audit/engines-sites-audit.md.
